name: MonsterDeleter
tagline: Summon a desktop pet monster to smash your files into the recycle bin
description: MonsterDeleter is a playful Windows desktop app that turns file deletion into a show. Instead of a boring system prompt, you summon a giant monster that walks over to the file and kicks it — together with the trash can — into pieces. It features a sniper-style translucent UI with a red crosshair cursor, hand-crafted frame-by-frame monster animations (with green-screen support), BGM, monster voice lines, and explosion sound effects. After one run it registers a "Summon the monster to delete" entry in the Windows right-click menu, and deletion actually uses send2trash so files can be recovered from the recycle bin.
highlights: Sniper-style translucent UI with a red crosshair cursor
Hand-crafted frame-by-frame monster animations with green-screen support
BGM, monster voice, and explosion sound effects
Right-click menu integration after a single run
Uses send2trash, so deleted files stay recoverable
curatorNote: Deleting files will never be this fun again. The polish — animations, sound design, sniper UI — is way beyond what a joke project needs, and send2trash means it is even safe.
